cases_used.how_applied: Added a low-32-bit shim; discovered the shim alone was insufficient because ivcore11 shared generic pointers carry a nonzero high-32 window base, then reconstructed (smem_base()|offset) in the CUTLASS shared load/store shims.

cases_used.symptom: divergent base ptr / NV PTX intrinsics rejected by llc backend
cases_used.how_applied: Replaced NV ld.global/st.global/ld.shared PTX in CUTLASS arch/memory.h + memory_sm75.h with generic C++.

cases_used.symptom: __CUDA_ARCH__=300, cudaDeviceProp.major does not map to NV, NV numeric gates
cases_used.how_applied: Bypassed __CUDA_ARCH__/__CUDACC_VER static_asserts and enabled fp16 paths via defined(__ILUVATAR__) (stable across host/device/JIT passes).

cases_used.symptom: warpSize=64 vs 32 breaks warp-level (shfl/ballot/reduce) and CUTLASS SIMT warp tile geometry
cases_used.how_applied: Identified as the root cause of the CutlassMLP SIMT GEMM livelock (blocker 1, terminal).

cases_used.symptom: no Volta+ Independent Thread Scheduling; spin/lock/divergent-progress algorithms deadlock
cases_used.how_applied: Considered as a contributing factor to the GEMM hang; combined with warp32-to-warp64 makes upstream NV CUTLASS SIMT unusable without ixCUTLASS.

cases_used.symptom: bare SDK texture API (tex2D / cudaCreateTextureObject) unavailable / silently wrong
cases_used.how_applied: Replaced texture sampling in the sample and image benchmark with a manual bilinear sampler over a plain device buffer.

cases_used.symptom: driver residue after a hung/killed kernel -> subsequent cuda_init hangs even when ixsmi looks clean
cases_used.how_applied: Used 'ixsmi -i 1 -r' (GPU-1-only, leaving GPU 0's concurrent migration untouched) to reset between runs and obtain clean measurements.

cases_used.symptom: JIT fusion needs NV mma PTX + cc>=75 + IXRTC device link
cases_used.how_applied: Kept RTC enabled for linking but relied on supports_jit_fusion()==false (cc=71) so JIT self-skips; classified JIT/FullyFused as terminal (blocker 2).
